desc: Water inlet error – drum does not fill within set time.
fix: Check tap is open and hose not kinked. Clean inlet valve mesh filter. Test inlet valve coil resistance and PCB output.

desc: Drain error – water not pumped out.
fix: Clean drain pump filter and hose. Check pump for blockage/impeller damage and its wiring. Check drain hose height.
Redistribute laundry, level machine, check shock absorbers and suspension springs.

Measure heater resistance, check NTC sensor and heater relay on the PCB.
Check motor wiring and carbon brushes, test triac on control board.

desc: Motor rotor blocked / tacho signal missing.
fix: Check tacho generator and wiring, free the drum, inspect motor.
Measure NTC resistance, check connector, replace sensor.

desc: Drain / pressure switch fault – water not draining.
fix: Clean pump filter, check pump, pressure switch and hose.

desc: Heating element relay stuck / heater circuit fault.
fix: Check heater resistance and relay on the board; replace faulty part.
